description: This file contains functions that generate instruction messages for various tools, such as creating new tasks, rules, bug reports, and condensing conversation summaries. It is used to facilitate structured interactions with the user for project management and documentation purposes.

methods.name: newTaskToolResponse
methods.description: Generates a structured instruction message for creating a new task with preloaded context, tailored to the user's input.

methods.name: newRuleToolResponse
methods.description: Creates a detailed instruction message for generating a new project-specific Kilo rule markdown file based on user instructions.

methods.name: reportBugToolResponse
methods.description: Prepares an instruction message to assist the user in submitting a detailed bug report to the GitHub issues page.

methods.name: condenseToolResponse
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive summary of the conversation to condense context while retaining key information for ongoing work.
